status: Experimental native integration implemented; not a verified self-ending alarm release

implemented.scheduling: AlarmManager.schedule with fixed schedules for Smart Alarm and Indirect Method
implemented.sound: Separate four-second PCM CAF copies in Library/Sounds; originals retained
implemented.automatic_stop: AlarmManager.stop at the scheduled time plus four seconds while code executes; actual-state observation, cancel fallback, retry and late-resume handling
implemented.recovery: Persist reservations and cancellation intent before daemon changes
implemented.intervals: Every integer 10–60 minutes; queue up to 12 hours, closest 96 combined entries; replenished while executing
implemented.watch_routing: Apple system alert forwarding; no watch app, WatchConnectivity, custom haptic loop or separate Watch queue.

not_proven: No repeat immediately after custom-file EOF
Indefinite repeat without any application execution
Exact sound/haptic presentation and dismissal on the user’s paired Watch
activation: Requires explicit disclosure acceptance and native AlarmKit permission; does not silently fall back to phone notifications

evidence.finding: Provides schedule, stop, cancel and alarmUpdates; these are called by this native implementation.
Alert-only presentation needs no countdown extension; stopIntent is associated with user dismissal, not an alarm-fired callback.
App timers are not a guarantee of code execution at a deadline while suspended.
Scheduled alarms survive app termination; queue capacity depends on system resources.

next_step: Compile in Xcode 26+, execute core and AVFoundation checks, then inspect acoustic and log results from repeated 60-second probes plus real 10–60-minute locked-screen intervals without debugger attachment.
